name: Structure: Fix the rule that the environment names no person in a room
text_content:
P14, P15, P20, and P30, the one thing on the S10 page a later session cannot revise at ordinary cost. No opener asks how anyone is; no brief, close, gathering, or review carries a read or a correction of a person; the grid appears on no record about a person; every speech act's destination is a record and not a room; the private correction is the check-in's. A later session may add an item to the slot's list, change the rotation floor, define the score, and design what Session 12 does with a correction; no later session may put a person's state, work style, or failure into any room the roster or the house is in. Written as a structural rule on the mechanism map beside Session 6's four dimensions and Session 9's order of every read. High.

Filed by Session 10 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmj2u. Reasoning lives on the S10 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.

Nothing about a horizon window, a line, or a move is said at the brief, the close, the gathering, or the leads' review beyond a count on the mechanism, and the window's block and check-ins are between two people with an interpreter designation where needed. S14 page, sections 5.1, 6.2, and 9; P16, P24, P33.
